title: alchemilla coriacea subsp. inconcinna
intro: Alchemilla coriacea subsp. inconcinna, commonly known as alpine lady's mantle, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. It is primarily used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating menstrual cramps due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of alpine lady's mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
